title: Why a Manual Escrow Service is the Future of E-Commerce in Pakistan
excerpt: Understand how manual escrow services in Pakistan bridge the trust gap between unknown buyers and sellers, ensuring secure transactions and zero financial risk.
content: The e-commerce landscape in Pakistan lacks a universal, trusted COD (Cash on Delivery) alternative that protects both parties equally. Sellers fear non-serious buyers rejecting parcels, while buyers fear receiving fake items after advance payment. A manual escrow service acts as a neutral third party that holds funds safely during transit. OloBuy's escrow architecture solves this exact problem by verifying orders manually, validating transactions, and ensuring seamless trade growth. As digital entrepreneurship expands into tier-2 and tier-3 cities across Pakistan, manual escrow is rapidly becoming the gold standard for secure digital commerce.
